name: Adapter-only provider evolution
statement: New providers implement and register primitives, identity semantics and declarative capabilities. Preserve one canonical coordinator, authorized session intersection, source preservation, independent integrity evidence, job identity, Atlas instrumentation and SDK/UI compatibility. Unsupported operations remain explicit.

org.redown.authority: Owner Phase 2.6 assignment plus mandatory adapter-only addendum in docs/phase26; observed implementation is partial, not accepted intent or certification.
